recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-11085; any broader cross-resource search behavior belongs to the FHIR-12148 family, while FHIR-12226 already covers the duplicate typo report.
issue_request: FHIR-11085 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the Search page, raised against DSTU2 section 2.42.1.4.20. It asked to change `GET [base]/Observation?_type=Observation,Condition&other params...` to a root-level search such as `GET [base]?_type=Observation,Condition&other params...`, because asking for Observation and Condition under the Observation endpoint is not meaningful.
initial_application: The Jira comment says this was already fixed. No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-11085, but the same correction was applied through FHIR-12226: svn @10123 appears in git as 785a04a465032908316dcf4741f24a769c6c194b, whose message includes `#12226 Fix typo in search specification for _type parameter` and whose patch changed `source/search.html` from `GET [base]/Observation?_type=Observation,Condition&other params...` to `GET [base]/?_type=Observation,Condition&other params...`.
additional_context: FHIR-12226 is the same-change-family issue and is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit a1e44f2063a3f6a58c1573dced5f0a3821a6ebe7. FHIR-12148 is the broader Published/Persuasive with Modification decision describing cross-resource searches on the base endpoint with `_type`. Current `source/search.html` uses `GET [base]/?_type=Observation,Condition&patient=Patient/123`, current `source/http.html` uses `GET [base]?_type=Condition,Observation...`, and `publish.ini` lists both pages as published outputs. Community searches found no FHIR-11085-specific Zulip or Confluence record that conflicts with the Jira/source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current authoritative source no longer contains the resource-qualified typo and already conveys the root/base-endpoint cross-resource search semantics requested by the issue.
